library.kw_042:r_c5a02ba6dd54bdec.text:
A nickname for 'Dimension Grizzly'.
The $$ＤＧ$$ is the largest and strongest of the certified hostile alien species, the Beasts.
It resembles the grizzly bear of North America but is far larger and more ferocious. It is also highly intelligent, and it is not unusual for one to read a pursuing hunter's movements, lure them in and turn the hunt around.
For that reason anyone who has killed a $$ＤＧ$$ is called a G-$$ハンター$$, a distinction among Beast Hunters that earns real respect.
A $$ＤＧ$$'s fang is also prized as a good-luck charm.

library.kw_042:r_a94560bed2f7fe7f.text:
A nickname for 'Dimension Grizzly'.
The $$ＤＧ$$ is the largest and strongest of the certified hostile alien species, the Beasts.
It resembles the grizzly bear of North America but is far larger and more ferocious. It is also highly intelligent, and it is not unusual for one to read a pursuing hunter's movements, lure them in and turn the hunt around.
For that reason anyone who has killed a $$ＤＧ$$ is called a G-$$ハンター$$, a distinction among Beast Hunters that earns real respect.
A $$ＤＧ$$'s fang is also prized as a good-luck charm, and recent research has drawn attention to the idea that this is not mere superstition but that the fang genuinely distorts causality.

library.kw_042:r_40d1d5e630e752cb.text:
Formally the $$人革連$$.
One of the three great nations before the Earth Federation was founded, an alliance centred on China, Russia and India.
It was at the $$人革連$$'s research body, the Superhuman Institute, that the Super Soldiers who use quantum brainwaves were created.

library.kw_042:r_8a6ce680c9d25f5f.text:
A spiral nebula roughly 260,000 light years across.
It holds over two hundred inhabited planets, but they are split between the two great powers of Gilgamesh and Balarant, locked in continuing confrontation. The Third Galactic War, called the Hundred Years War, lived up to its name and ran for a full century; ATs saw combat in its later stages.
The confrontation between the two camps has gone on for over a thousand years, and its cause was the scheming of Wiseman, the hidden ruler of the $$アストラギウス$$ galaxy. Even after Wiseman fell, however, the war continues.

library.kw_042:r_7a6b76feaa6f3e12.text:
A special forces unit answering directly to the president.
Commanded by $$レディ・アン$$, with every member holding a code name.
It functions largely as an intelligence unit, tasked with preventing wars and acts of terror before they happen.

library.kw_042:r_e68a074da1a34742.text:
The biological wavelength and signal used by Super Soldiers, Innovades and Innovators to commune with one another's minds. Quantum brainwaves can also be used to access the quantum computing system '$$ヴェーダ$$'.
GN particles help carry quantum brainwaves, and under a high concentration of them even ordinary humans can commune this way.

library.kw_042:r_29ba12e8eb9a7c28.text:
A site on the $$ＵＮ$$ dealing in occult information of every kind.
The largest of its genre, it is busy day and night with everything from cryptids to interdimensional beings, urban legends and mythology.
Given the subject matter the credibility of its threads is poor, and no small number of users are there to jeer or spread hoaxes. Even so, some post their own research and theories there in an honest attempt to widen what is known.

library.kw_042:r_caee38a34962a3e2.text:
The information network system used in $$ＵＣＷ$$.
Short for 'Universal Network' and pronounced 'U-N'.
It was laid down to unify and share information across the multiverse, and anyone with a terminal can read or publish on it.
A valuable source of information for citizens and an entertainment medium at the same time, it became a critically important piece of infrastructure across the multiverse.
It was adopted as the unified standard for information infrastructure in the post-Neo-$$時空震動$$ world as well.

library.kw_042:r_1d00c83d09a8b869.text:
The continent that was sealed off from the outside by a dimensional wall in $$ＡＤＷ$$.
Its cultural forms differ from those of the other continents.
After the dimensional wall vanished, its rulers were toppled largely by the resistance. Following the end of the $$破界事変$$, however, a spacequake isolated it behind a dimensional wall once more, and it passed about ten years while a single year went by elsewhere.
Once the wall vanished a second time it came under the Earth Federation.
It is now known as the $$新世界大陸$$.

library.kw_042:r_206b211d4587aedc.text:
The present name of the $$暗黒大陸$$.
Chosen through a campaign by residents who objected to being called the $$暗黒大陸$$, for the sense of hope for the future it carries.

library.kw_042:r_c492805c4093670f.text:
A mysterious power granted by a holder of a Code.
Its nature differs with the bearer, so the abilities vary widely.
$$ルルーシュ$$'s $$ギアス$$ is the 'power of absolute obedience', letting him force a command on anyone whose eyes he meets. Gaps in memory are seen around the moment a $$ギアス$$ is cast and while it is active. The ability can be used on any one person only once.
A $$ギアス$$ grows stronger the more it is used, and eventually enters a range the bearer cannot control. Past that point the $$ギアス$$ sigil appears in both eyes, and a bearer in that state can inherit a Code from its holder.

library.kw_042:r_2920eaf9a6e912ad.text:
The newest model of petit mobile suit for industrial work.
Formally the 'Tolro-built Petit Mobile Suit TOLRO-800', though the nickname $$トロハチ$$ has stuck.
It is in use on Industrial 7 as well; it was in one of these that $$バナージ$$ caught the falling $$オードリー$$ and saved her.

library.kw_042:r_2bcc7cb5a4d785ca.text:
The nickname of Industrial 7's colony builder 'Magallanica'.
$$カーディアス・ビスト$$'s residence stands there.

library.kw_042:r_b5a17f59e366cd5d.text:
The title given to those who graduate $$ザフト$$'s academy with top marks.
Because they are issued a red-based uniform on assignment, they are also called '$$ザフト$$ Red'.

library.kw_042:r_46ab88d386b281f8.text:
The war between the Principality of Zeon, which declared independence, and the Earth Federation.
It is called by this name because roughly a year passed between the opening of hostilities and the end of the war.
The $$一年戦争$$ was the first in history to field mobile suits, and it overturned every strategy and tactic that came before.
Though the Principality of Zeon was defeated, the name of Zeon lived on in many changed forms and still carries great weight in the friction between Spacenoids and Earthnoids.

library.kw_042:r_d2f3e41f7f5f829e.text:
Full name Gilbert $$デュランダル$$.
Chairman of the $$プラント$$ Supreme Council.
Unlike his predecessor $$パトリック・ザラ$$, he is a moderate who sought a road to coexistence and peace with Naturals. During the $$ユニウスセブン$$ drop and the fighting with the $$地球連合$$ that followed, he consistently made calm, accurate judgements and showed excellent leadership.
An authority on genetic research, it was through that work that he came to know Rau Le Creuset and Rey Za Burrel. He also marked $$シン$$'s talent early.
His ultimate aim was to build a managed society controlling humanity at the genetic level, which he called the 'Destiny Plan'. After destroying $$ロゴス$$, which had controlled the history of human warfare from the shadows, he declared the plan's introduction to the world, only to be stopped by $$キラ$$ and the others, who refused a world where evolution would halt.
At the last he was shot by Rey, whom he had trusted like a true son. He closed his life held by Talia, once his lover, who had gone on caring for him even after they parted.

library.kw_042:r_42bcd8c8b91a5847.text:
$$プラント$$'s military organisation, short for 'Zodiac Alliance of Freedom Treaty'.
It grew out of a political body formed around Siegel Clyne and $$パトリック・ザラ$$, and is made up of Coordinator volunteers. All are trained to fight on land, at sea and in the air alike, and the most capable soldiers among them are issued a red-based uniform.
It has no ranks in the manner of a normal military, and units are named directly after their commanders.
Supreme command rests with the $$プラント$$ Supreme Council's Chairman of National Defence.

library.kw_042:r_001be1f7e51f4d31.text:
The special duty corps of $$ザフト$$, $$プラント$$'s self-defence organisation. Short for 'Fast Acting Integrate Tactical Headquarters'.
Only those recognised for outstanding character or combat record are admitted, with the approval of the Chairman of National Defence and the Chairman of the $$プラント$$ Supreme Council. A silver badge is issued as proof, and its bearers draw respect and envy alike.
Despite the name, members are not attached to a unit: they are permitted to act and to give orders on their own judgement.
Their authority is considerable - enough to issue orders even to a commander in the field.

library.kw_042:r_6e8d4508728dcd9c.text:
The organisation that declared war on the World Nation in pursuit of independence for the colonies.
Under its leader Milliardo Peacecraft, it fought the World Nation led by $$トレーズ$$ Khushrenada.
The organisation collapsed when Milliardo lost his duel with $$ヒイロ・ユイ$$, and with the end of that battle the world entered a new age.

library.kw_042:r_414b8e4ba26deeca.text:
A counter-offensive in which the colonies from L1 to L5 dropped the mobile suits known as 'Gundams' into the atmosphere to strike at the United Earth $$スフィア$$ Alliance and OZ.
The colonies were not acting in concert: each carried out the operation on its own judgement, and each descending Gundam acted on its own judgement too.
In the end that Gundam drop set the age in motion, and the world entered a new era aimed at peace.

library.kw_042:r_ad2f2b27f99f4ea1.text:
A counter-offensive in which the colonies from L1 to L5 dropped the mobile suits known as 'Gundams' into the atmosphere to strike at the United Earth $$スフィア$$ Alliance and OZ.
The colonies were not acting in concert: each carried out the operation on its own judgement, and each descending Gundam acted on its own judgement too.
In the end that Gundam drop set the age in motion, and the world entered a new era aimed at peace.
It was later revealed by $$デキム・バートン$$ that the true $$オペレーション・メテオ$$ had been a plan to drop a colony, throw Earth into chaos, and seize the planet with the Gundams while it reeled.

library.kw_042:r_811b7ba359460452.text:
The emperor who rules the planet Gishin.
He schemes to rule the whole universe through fear and violence, and treats the inhabitants of every world he subjugates as pieces serving his ambition.
Though he commands many subordinates, he thinks of every one of them as little more than a tool. He never forgives those who defy his will or betray him, and his cruelty runs to telling a subordinate who tried to take his own life out of shame at failure to 'die for my sake' instead.
He was defeated by $$タケル$$'s desperate fight after $$タケル$$ stormed Gishin, but vanished leaving ominous words behind.
He duly returned as those words promised, and was struck down once again by $$タケル$$, who carried the hopes of a great many people.

library.kw_042:r_4ccc4cfcd905a83a.text:
$$タケル$$'s twin brother (identical).
Separated from his brother soon after birth, he lost his father to execution and then his mother when he was ten. On learning that $$ズール$$ was the cause of all of it, he resolved on revenge.
Feigning a broken mind to get close to $$ズール$$, he resisted him through an information war, using telepathy to pass $$タケル$$ the secret of $$ゴッドマーズ$$ and warning of attacks from Gishin.
He was reunited with $$タケル$$, but lost his life in battle. His will to fight for the peace of the universe passed to $$タケル$$.
When $$ズール$$ returned, he went on calling encouragement to $$タケル$$ from the world of the dead. At times he borrowed $$ロゼ$$'s body to become the Rose Knight and support him directly - still, in death, standing by his beloved brother.

library.kw_042:r_b7360722d80a998b.text:
The great disaster that struck the South Pole fifteen years ago.
Its cause is unknown. Half of humanity perished, and the seas have since become a red ocean in which almost all life has died out.

library.kw_042:r_9b0ff0bfea864484.text:
A phenomenon in which, during an ultra-large-scale electromagnetic anomaly such as an earthquake, electromagnetic interference makes the 'space perceived as a quantum existence' resonate with a complex-number dimension.
The energy that flows in through a $$界震$$ produces a $$ヘテロダイン$$.

library.kw_042:r_6a69f0bf727e7ecd.text:
The phenomenon in which energy emerging from another dimension through a $$界震$$ behaves as though it were alive. It also refers to that energy itself.
The energy gathers around a Fractal Knot as its core and takes on an enormous form. Being pure energy it has no thought or awareness, but it does have habits, such as being drawn to electromagnetic waves.
Destroying the original Fractal Knot at its core causes it to collapse.
